4607.title: Scheduled-message promotion loses delivery provenance
4607.rootCauseOneLine: Explicit promotion consumes the scheduled row without retaining its queue id, original deadline or override reason in the durable outbound request; automatic early release was not reproduced.
4607.proposedFix: Define and propagate a durable schedule-provenance contract. This changes a public event/schema surface and is outside the simple-fix rule.
4607.caveats: Same-agent second clean run; server/hub harness, not live Codex. Confidence is high for the provenance gap only. The historical early arrival and durable wake across restart remain unverified.
